description:
Permanently deletes one object of the user's JusticeLibre account: a case file (with all its content), a saved reference, a subfolder, a note, or an AI skill proposal not yet activated (`skill`, id s_… or p_…). No recycle bin. confirm=true states the user's explicit agreement; without it, nothing is deleted. Permission supprimer; a reference the AI saved itself can also be removed with permission notes_ia. To keep a trace with a reason instead: update_account_item with set_aside. Requires a JusticeLibre account (OAuth sign-in).

Example: delete_account_item(what="note", id="n_…", confirm=true)

confirm.description: true = the user explicitly agreed; otherwise nothing is deleted.
confirm.title: Confirm

what.description: "folder", "element" (saved reference), "subfolder", "note" or "skill" (AI skill proposal not yet activated).
what.title: What

name: delete_account_item
